sources.title: BLIP-3: A Family of Open Large Multimodal Models - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract This paper introduces BLIP-3, an open framework for developing Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). The framework comprises meticulously curated datasets, a training recipe, model architectures, and a resulting suite of LMMs. We release 4B and 14B models, including both the pre-trained base model and the instruction fine-tuned ones.
